_comment: A Cartographer's CONFIG_VERSION carries no commit, so FlashLog.entry_for's version-based discard clause is the only thing that can invalidate a stale record when there is no running_sha to check against. Dropping it would let a board hand-flashed outside this tool keep a record that still looks believable - a silent wrong answer.

mutations.name: the sha-less discard clause runs when there is no running commit
a disagreeing recorded version is not ignored
